tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bhaṭṭa ra ka ha sye badzra gyis gsung zer 'ga' bdog bzhugs so// na mo badzra dhwa dza ye/ thog mar go myong thugs la 'khrungs pa tshigs bcad du bsdebs pa/ ma rig rkyen gyi 'du byed sogs/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis bsdus lus/ /rnam smin sha khrag rnam shes bcas/ /dge sdig las kun 'dis gsog cing / /yar 'gro mar 'gro'i sa mtshams yin/ /khe nyen tshe 'di nyin skar tsam/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gnag dka' las/ /thar 'dod bla ma la brten nas/ /skyabs 'gro la sogs sdom pa blangs/ /ci gsung dwang len dam tshig bsrung / /'di ni gnad ka dang po lags/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag pa/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs bsams pas/ /nges 'byung skyes na so thar skye/ /byams brtses kun bslangs gzhan don du/ /go cha bgos la byang sdom mo/ /mtshan ldan brgyud pa ma nyams shing / /dbang bzhi brda don 'phrod thob pas/ /sngags sdom thob cing lta sgom dbang / /de yang mtshan nyid theg pa dang / /thun mong gang zag bdag med ni/ /lung rigs rgyu mtshan du ma yis/ /nga bdag btsal bas ma rnyed pa/ /de ni gang zag bdag med yin/ /de ltar rtogs nas mnyam par bzhag /rgyu mtshan du mas 'bad bsgoms pas/ /rnam rtog rgyun chad rtog med song / /lo zla zhag sogs mi shes 'byung / /de ni zhi gnas skyes pa yin/ /de bskyang rmugs par ma song bar/ /ngar 'don byas pas gsal snang skye/ /de ni so skye'i lhag mthong tsam/ /mtshan nyid pa ni sa thob nas/ /'byung ngo da lta med par go /lha sku la sogs mthong snang rnams/ /sgom pa'i nyams snang tsam yin no/ /zhi gnas ngar 'don dang bcas dang / /so sor rtog pa'i dpyod dang bcas/ /lhag mthong thob phyir med thabs med/ /mtshan bcas mtshan med thams cad kyis/ /sngon du theg chen sems bskyed dang / /bar du lta ba rnam dag skyong / /tha mar bsngo smon rgya yis btab/ /dmigs med ngang nas spyod lam bya/

/ltogs pas zan thos mi phan ltar/ /go bas mi phan bsgom dgos so/ /lus la bab bskur lto gos la/ /gyong skur sems la las skur nas/ /snang ba gdong gded 'chi nus kyi/ /thog 'gel bya zhing ro snyom mo/ /zhes so/ /mar pa'i zhal lta/ sgrub gnas sogs dang / mi med kyi gnas mthun rkyen gang gang 'dzom du sgom sgrub pa nus na bla ma'i zhabs tog pha ma'i drin lan/ sems can gyi 'gro don rnams de ka rang gis grub pa yin/ sgrub pa ma nus na tshe ring po las ngan gsog che ba las med pas tshe 'di'i 'dun thag skyungs/ tshe 'di don du gnyer ba'i mi dang lab mi byed par sgrub pa la 'bungs shig gsungs spyan chab nyil nyil mdzad/ 'dir dpon slob phan tshun ma brjed pa dgos tshul gsungs/ bka' drin can gong ma'i rnam thar la/ /bsams na gdams ngag de nyid rang / /mang po thob 'dod g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ /gnad kyi gsung snying la chongs sogs/ mi med kyi rdza brag pha yi mkhar/ /grogs med gcig pu lha yi yul/ /sems la sems zhon chad med rta/ /pha yul du slob dpon gyis bu la gsungs/ /dang po pha yod tsa na bu nga med/ /bu nga yod tsa na pha yang med/ /gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med/ /bu nga snying po'i lha chos byed/ /rim gro gsungs pa/ 'khor ba'i bya ba bsags na 'dzad/ /bcos na 'jig 'dus na 'bral/ skyes na 'chi ba sogs kyis sdug bsngal yong nges pa rang sdug rang gis shom pa'i las 'di dang po nas blos btang ste/ mi gsog mi 'chos/ mi 'du bar/ mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' bzhin skye med kyi don nyams su len pa rnams thabs dang rim gro mchog yin/ yang gzhan phan sems bskyed kyis ma zin pa'i rang gis tshe 'di'i ched du gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga byed pa/ ye shes kyi lha rnams rgyal po khri steng nas phyag dar gyi las la spyan 'dren pa lta bu'i nyes pa yod gsungs/ rang rgyud chos dang mi bsre ba'i/ /rgyud sde bzung bas ci la phan/

/'jig rten bya ba ma btang ba'i/ /gdams ngag sgom pas ci la phan/ /phyogs ris chags sdang ma spang ba'i/ /mchod pa 'bul bas ci la phan/ /ci gsung tshad mar mi 'dzin pa'i/ /bu slob mang pos ci la phan/ /pur khang me nang nas/ ras chung pa'i glu len/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ru/ /lus kyi phung po sdig po che/ /lto gos kyi zhen pa sgrub sgrub nas/ /'jig rten bya ba thongs dus med/ /'jig rten bya ba thong cig ras chung pa/ /dpal dar 'bum la gsungs pa/ thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa phyi'i khrid/ /rig pa rdo rus sprod pa nang gi khrid/ /nyams rtogs 'du 'bral med pa don gyi 'khrid/ /g.yag ru thang pa'i grwa pa tshor gsungs pa/ nang rang rgyud sems nyid ma thul ba'i/ /phyi dmu rgod sems can ga la thul/ /mtsho rnga rde'u chung gi ras chung ma se mo dor ngag bcad kyis lo brgyad bsgoms nas mkha' spyod du gshegs/ mi kha byur gyi kha lab la/ /the tshom za na rang nyid 'khrul/ /sgom sgrub snying nas byed dus su/ /'gro 'dug mang ba bar chad yin/ /dharma bho dhi'i mgur/ rnam rtog bag chags ma zhig pa'i/ /sems la bltas pas ci la phan/ /bdag 'dzin skyid 'dod ma spangs pa'i/ /yun du bsgoms pas ci la phan/ /lar yin lugs bshad pas gnongs la 'phog /'khrug pa byas na phung gzhi che/ /kha rog bsdad pa gdams ngag zab/ /ras chung pa'i glu len/ spyod pa mi dang mthun na mdzes/ /bsam pa mchod grogs mnyes pas 'grub/ /byin rlabs bla ma mnyes pas 'ong / /rang don rang rtsis chung bas 'grub/ /chos pa bshes ngan spangs na yin/ /mi kha drin can bkur na byams/ /gtam snyan snyoms chung bskyangs na yong / /dam tshig ngo lkog med na gtsang / /yon tan rje dang 'grogs na skye/ /'dre kha rnam rtog chung na khegs/ /bzang po byams sems che na 'ong / /lar mkhas pa'i nye ba thams cad yin/ /blun pos dgra gnyen ngo mi shes/ /rdzas dang longs spyod khe grags gsum/

/'di gsum rnal 'byor gyi bar chad yin/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis spang 'tshal lo/ /gnyen dang yon bdag slob ma gsum/ /de gsum rnal 'byor gyi bshol 'debs yin/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis spang 'tshal lo/ /chang dang ngal dub gnyid dang gsum/ /de gsum rnal 'byor gyi chom po yin/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis spang 'tshal lo/ /gtam dang gad mo ltad mo gsum/ /de gsum rnal 'byor gyi g.yeng ba yin/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis spang 'tshal lo/ /bla ma dang gdams ngag dad pa gsum/ /de gsum rnal 'byor gyi gzhi rten yin/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi sgrub 'tshal lo/ /dben gnas grogs mchog 'tsho ba gsum/ /de gsum rnal 'byor gyi mkhar ba yin/ /zhes sogs dwags po lha rjer gsungs pa/ mngon shes shar tsa na lha'i bu'i bdud 'jug pas shin tu gsang ba gal che/ spyir yang gsang sngags gsang nas 'grub pas gsang la sgrubs/ lar dbang po rnon po rgyu'i stobs can la bdud kyis mi tshugs so/ /ras chung pa la gsungs pa/ gangs la gnas pa'i seng ge dang / /nags la gnas pa'i rgya stag dang / /chab la gnas pa'i nya mo gsum/ /'di gsum sbas na ngo mtshar che/ /'di gsum sbas na dgra yang nyung / /'di gsum phyi'i dpe gsum lags/ /nang gi don la sbyar tsa na/ /rnal 'byor pa yi lus dang gcig /gsang sngags thabs kyi lam dang gnyis/ /nyams su myong ba'i 'bras bu gsum/ /'di gsum sbas na ngo mtshar che/ /'di gsum sbas na dgra yang nyung / /'di sbed sbed pa nyung bar gda'/ /de phyir bod na grub thob nyung / /brin sa chu rtswa la rtsod tshe gsungs/ /spyi pa dang bar pa gros 'debs gsum/ /phyogs ris zug rngu skye ba'i rgyu/ /phyogs med rang sa 'dzin 'dod na/ /gnyer med lkugs pa mkhyen lags sam/ /pha yul dang nor rdzas gnyen 'brel gsum/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol 'dod na/ /'khri ba btsan chod mkhyen lags sam/ /rang 'dod dang g.yo rgyu zol zog gsum/

/ngan song gsum du lhung ba'i rgyu/ /mtho ris thar lam thob 'dod na/ /rang sems drang po mkhyen lags sam/ /bshad pa dang bshes gnyen bgro gleng gsum/ /nga rgyal phrag dog skye ba'i rgyu/ /dam chos nyams su len 'dod na/ /dman sa 'dzin dgos mkhyen lags sam/ /'thab ka dang las ka ngo srung gsum/ /rnal 'byor bsam gtan bshig pa'i rgyu/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes skyong 'dod na/ /khrel med gdong chung mkhyen lags sam/ /dpon dang g.yog dang slob rigs gsum/ /g.yeng ba sems khral skye ba'i rgyu/ /gcig pur nyams su len 'dod na/ /dpon med g.yog med mkhyen lags sam/ /mthu dang nus pa tho cho gsum/ /rnal 'byor rang srog skyel ba'i rgyu/ /dam chos mtha' ru 'don 'dod na/ /'jol mo'i rnam thar༞ /chos 'gal nyes pa rgyu mthun la/ /gnyen po rim pa bdun gyi dbyangs/ /snya nam nya ma tshor gsungs pa/ gtam snyan grags 'dod pa'i tshogs bsog dang / /tshe 'di'i 'jigs skyob skyabs gnas dang / /lan la re ba 'dod pa'i sbyin pa dang / /ngas byas rang 'dod kyi 'bul ba bzhi/ /de la nam phugs yod ma yin/ /sring mor/ gzhon nas snying rus ma byas pa'i/ /rgas nas byed bsam ci la phan/ /mtshams dang smra bcad dam pa na/ /mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs 'jug pa yin/ /sems la skyid 'dod med pa na/ /rnam smin sgrib pa sbyang ba yin/ /sgom yun shi dang mnyam nus na/ /yangs rgyal dgung dang mnyam pa yin/ /ras chung dam tshig gso dus su/ /mkhas btsun thams cad thugs mthun pas/ /pho rus chags sdang byed pa rnams/ /bslab tshad chu la pho ba yin/ /grub mtha' kha 'dzin chos la smod/ /thar pa'i 'ju thag chad pa yin/ /bu slob rnams la/ 'gag dang gnad dmigs mi shes na/ /mang po shes zer 'chal ba yin/ /sems kyi rtsa ba ma rtogs na/ /lo mang sgom zer rdzun ma yin/ /zhing dang bsam pa ma 'brel na/ /rgyu mang btang yang chud zos yin/ /phyogs med sbyin pa ma btang na/

/grogs gang bzang mchod pa kha lan yin/ /gang la gang 'gro mi shes pa'i/ /glen pa'i drang gtam ltung ba'i gzhi/ /gang la gang phan shes pa na/ /mkhas pas rdzun smras dge ba yin/ /nga la rgyu med zer ba na/ /rmongs pa'i rmongs gtam kun la gnod/ /dge ba sems la shar ba na/ /sa rdo rtsi shing dge ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa 'di'ang buddha lakṣ+mīs bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bhwa ra ka ha badzra gyis gsung zer 'ga' bdog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
